5d1c819a86f7743b355c4887 Name: Killer Innovations Velocity Compensator for Glock 17
5d1c819a86f7743b355c4887 Description: A bore-centric compensator from Killer Innovations. This compensator installs without set screws interfering with the barrel threads, using a proprietary locking ring system for perfect alignment with the Velocity Slide. Significantly reduces muzzle flip.
5e4ab6d386f774069611c792 Name: CMC Triggers Match Precision Fluted Barrel for Glock 17
5e4ab6d386f774069611c792 Description: A drop-in match grade barrel for the Glock 17 manufactured by CMC Triggers. Machined from stress-relieved 416R stainless steel with a straight fluted profile for heat dissipation and a bead-blasted finish.
5a7ae1a651dfba0017554316 Name: ETS Group Gen 2 Transparent Magazine for Glock 9x19 (21-round)
5a7ae1a651dfba0017554316 Description: A transparent polymer magazine by Elite Tactical Systems (ETS) for Glock 9mm systems. The clear body allows for immediate visual recognition of round count and ammo type. Features extreme impact resistance and creep-resistant feed lips.
59e6906286f7746c9f75e848 Name: Night Fision Stealth Tritium Front Sight (Glock)
59e6906286f7746c9f75e848 Description: A front sight by Night Fision. They feature Swiss tritium vials housed in a specialized sleeve for maximum durability and a crisp, defined sight picture in low-light conditions.
6973e015a991f8f91bc3934c Name: Night Fision Stealth Tritium Rear Sight (Glock)
6973e0169fa0f88e07c3934e Description: A rear sight by Night Fision. They feature Swiss tritium vials housed in a specialized sleeve for maximum durability and a crisp, defined sight picture in low-light conditions.
62811f461d5df4475f46a333 Name: Killer Innovations Velocity Optic Cover Plate (Black)
62811f461d5df4475f46a333 Description: Billet machined cover plate for the Killer Innovations Velocity Slide. Manufactured from 6061-T6 Aluminum with a black anodized finish, this plate protects the optic cut when a red dot is not installed and continues the slide's aggressive aesthetic.
697bcc72c40392898c6eba4e Description: A rare, shortened 10-inch barrel for the AR-18 system. Originally designed for the experimental 'submachine gun' carbine variants tested in the mid-1960s, this barrel sacrifices muzzle velocity and range for superior ergonomics and maneuverability in close-quarters combat.
697bceffe0827153bf6eba53 Description: An extremely early prototype handguard for the AR-18 platform. Unlike the production fiberglass-reinforced nylon furniture, this unit is milled from hardwood, as seen on the Serial No. 004 test units. While it offers a unique classic look, it lacks the sophisticated heat shielding of the final production models.
697bd03cd161658bc16eba56 Description: A standard AR-18 pistol grip that has been retrofitted to mount onto the handguard as a vertical foregrip. This improvised configuration was utilized on early short-barreled prototypes to assist with recoil control during fully automatic fire. It provides a substantial point of contact for the support hand.
697be91ca234f290026eba5b Name: PIECE OF MIND X ILLICIT PROVISIONS MULTICAM ALPINE Magpul 30 Round Magazine
697be91ca234f290026eba5b Description: Piece of Mind has teamed up with illpro again to offer another limited run of Multicam Alpine PMAGS. This time, a 30 round windowed Magpul Pmag. Limited Mini Bully Patch set included with each order.
6986801b76c6b6cbd5104c03 Description: The Ultimax 100 is a Singaporean 5.56mm light machine gun. Renowned for its 'Constant Recoil' operating system, the bolt carrier group never strikes the rear of the receiver, resulting in exceptionally low recoil and smooth operation.
698684546cbf41bc20104c0b Description: The main receiver assembly for the Ultimax 100 light machine gun. Manufactured from stamped sheet metal to reduce weight, it houses the long-stroke gas piston system and the unique constant recoil spring assembly.
6986854b79ff444e95104c11 Description: A dedicated vertical foregrip for the Ultimax 100. While the weapon is famous for its low recoil, this grip aids in muzzle maneuverability and stability when firing from the shoulder or hip.
698685e38ee206f4d7104c13 Description: The standard issue quick-detach polymer buttstock for the Ultimax 100. It can be removed quickly to shorten the weapon for close-quarters combat or paratrooper operations, relying on the weapon's low recoil system for control without a shoulder point.
6986865b982d33ed14104c17 Description: A lightweight, height-adjustable bipod designed for the Ultimax 100 series. Essential for sustained suppression fire roles, providing a stable platform for the 100-round drum magazine.
6986819aa62cef0fb1104c04 Description: The signature 100-round polymer drum magazine for the Ultimax 100. Unlike belt-fed systems, this drum allows for rapid reloading while providing massive firepower. It is bulky, but reliable.
6987668597a5ba48fe104c1c Description: Standard adjustable aperture rear sight for the Ultimax 100. Calibrated for 5.56x45mm ball ammunition with range adjustments up to 1000 meters.
6987673c899d651b5c104c1e Description: An extremely short 10-inch 'Commando' barrel for the Ultimax 100. Designed for special forces and VIP protection details where concealability and maneuverability inside vehicles outweigh effective range and velocity.
69878723bc82111ece104c22 Description: A 13-inch 'Para' barrel for the Ultimax 100. This configuration balances compact handling with acceptable ballistics, making it a favorite for airborne and urban operations.
698787edae15a9a3a7104c25 Description: The standard 20-inch heavy barrel for the Ultimax 100. Designed to maximize muzzle velocity and heat dissipation during sustained automatic fire.
6987a062adeeb92b41104c27 Description: A proprietary 30-round box magazine for the Ultimax 100 system.
6998e5bd183a239134f7a065 Description: A specialized helmet cover for the FAST NGH series in the legendary AOR1 digital desert pattern. Originally issued exclusively to US Navy DEVGRU operators, finding an authentic piece in Tarkov is nearly impossible. Local legend says a small batch was brought in by a 'vacationing' Black Division consultant before the blockade. It provides excellent signature management in arid environments, though in the Norvinsk forests, it's mostly a status symbol for the extremely wealthy or lucky.
6917c4906c6dac68cc13588a Description: The woodland variant of the Navy's Area of Responsibility pattern. Designed for temperate and tropical jungle environments, it serves well in the overgrown suburbs of Tarkov. Often found in the kits of higher-tier USEC contractors who prefer something more specialized than standard MultiCam.
6998e5f7e34886d9bdf7a069 Name: Ops-Core FAST NGH helmet cover (MultiCam Alpine)
6998e5f7e34886d9bdf7a069 Description: A specialized white-out cover for high-altitude or deep winter operations. While the Norvinsk winters are brutal, these covers are usually seen on snipers lurking in the power station hills or during rare snowfalls. It drastically reduces the helmet's silhouette against bright, frozen backgrounds.
6998e5d477ac37a27df7a067 Description: A helmet cover featuring the Canadian Digital Pattern. This item is an anomaly in the region; Rumor has it a shipment intended for a Canadian UNPROFOR detachment was intercepted by local Scav bosses during the early days of the chaos. Its vibrant greens are perfectly suited for the deep woods of Shoreline and Reserve. Extremely rare and highly sought after by 'drip' enthusiasts.
6998e60c71292bd226f7a06b Name: Ops-Core FAST NGH helmet cover (Miami Tigerstripe)
6998e60c71292bd226f7a06b Description: A custom, non-standard 'Miami' variation of the classic Tigerstripe pattern. Likely a private purchase by a PMC with more money than sense, or a leftover from a flashy urban security detail. It offers questionable camouflage but undeniable style in the neon-lit halls of the Interchange.
6998e54173a6181d15f7a061 Description: The fifth generation of the ComTac series, featuring improved environmental microphones and better EMI shielding. This specific pair is finished in AOR1 and comes with the ARC rail adapters pre-installed. These were likely stripped from the gear of a high-value extraction team that didn't make it to the terminal.
6998e57bc11d47d1b7f7a063 Description: Standard issue for modern special operations units. These ComTac Vs are mounted on helmet adapters to provide constant hearing protection and comms integration. A reliable piece of tech that amplifies ambient noise while suppressing the deafening cracks of 7.62x39mm fire.
6998e48a9d7c140756f7a049 Description: The Next Generation High-cut helmet from Ops-Core, finished in the iconic AOR1 pattern. Finding a genuine maritime-spec shell in this pattern suggests the previous owner was part of an elite Tier 1 element. It offers lightweight Level III-A protection and is a 'white whale' for collectors in the Norvinsk region, usually only found in the hands of the most dangerous Raiders.
6998e4f8f156ad13a1f7a055 Description: A rare CADPAT-dipped version of the FAST NGH. Canadian military gear is a rarity in the Russian federation, and this piece likely arrived via a small JTF2 advisory group that was operating in secret near the Tarkov port along side Black Division. It blends into the Russian forest better than almost any other pattern, making it a deadly asset for those who prefer the shadows.
6998e428d9c1fe43aaf7a03d Description: A high-cut Next Generation Ballistic helmet finished in the Navy's AOR2 woodland digital pattern. While AOR1 is the 'trophy' of the desert, AOR2 is the practical choice for the damp, overgrown outskirts of the Norvinsk region. This particular unit was reportedly recovered from a crashed helicopter near the Shoreline pier, likely belonging to a maritime security detail that was attempting to bypass the Tarkov blockade by sea. It offers the same Level III-A protection as the standard FAST, but the factory-applied AOR2 finish makes it significantly harder to spot in the dense brush of the Woods.
69a9e29372c1dad0b5eee878 Description: A beautifully crafted scale model of the legendary CF-105 Avro Arrow. Looking at this supersonic beauty just makes you want to crack open a two-four of Molson and complain about Diefenbaker cancelling the program back in '59. A true piece of Canadian aviation history, perfect for displaying on the mantelpiece above the chesterfield.
69a9e443e43d97b015eee87a Description: A display model of a Canadian ten-dollar bill. It's got that nice smooth polymer feel, and you could probably use it to scrape the frost off your windshield in a pinch. It doesn't buy as many Timbits as it used to thanks to inflation, but it's an absolute beauty of a banknote.
69a9e463e2e8611ea1eee87c Description: A hand-carved wooden model of a majestic prairie bison. These absolute units used to roam the plains by the millions. Just looking at this little guy makes you want to pack up the camper and drive through Wood Buffalo National Park. Just remember: don't try to pet the real ones, eh?
69a9e483c1af313110eee87e Description: A taxidermied Canada Goose, affectionately known as the 'Cobra Chicken'. This pure manifestation of avian rage is usually found holding up traffic, covering sidewalks in green paste, or terrorizing pedestrians near the local pond. Keep your distance, buddy, or you'll be sorry.
69a9e4992e1165c50ceee880 Description: A miniature bronze statue of #99, the greatest hockey player to ever lace up a pair of skates. Whether he was setting up plays behind the net or lifting the Cup, The Great One is absolute Canadian royalty. You'd better put this up on the top shelf where mom hides the peanut butter.
69a9e4b0051564f259eee882 Name: Ford Escape RCMP Cruiser Die-cast Model
69a9e4b0051564f259eee882 Description: A die-cast model of a Royal Canadian Mounted Police cruiser, complete with the iconic crest on the door and the lightbar. It brings back fond memories of getting pulled over for doing 120 on the Trans-Canada Highway and getting a polite but firm warning from a guy wearing a funny hat.
69a9e4d574ee0c5acbeee884 Description: A Bauer hockey skate, somehow only the right one. If you close your eyes, it smells faintly of freezing ODRs, old locker rooms, and Olympic Gold's. An essential piece of decor for any true hoser's basement sanctuary.
69a9dfa0e55d527115eee872 Description:
The Dead Air Mask 22 is a compact powerhouse delivering top-tier performance, robust construction, and remarkable versatility. Constructed with a titanium tube and stainless steel baffles, it's designed to handle a wide spectrum of calibers without barrel restrictions, from .22LR to 5.7x28.

Measuring just 5.1 inches in length, the Dead Air Mask combines optimal sound suppression with a full auto rating, eliminating the notorious first-round pop. The .22 caliber suppressor is user-serviceable allowing users to clean their suppressor with ease.
69a9e0fb79fe0b0af4eee874 Description:

69a9bd241c35419872eee854 Description: The vz. 58 is a 7.62x39mm assault rifle designed and manufactured in Czechoslovakia. While it externally resembles the AK-47, it uses a completely different short-stroke gas piston operating system, is striker-fired, and shares no parts with Kalashnikov rifles. Known for its lightweight milled receiver and extreme reliability.
69a9d7364e93c2f8a7eee85e Description: The standard stamped steel dust cover for the vz. 58 assault rifle. Protects the internal striker mechanism and bolt carrier from dirt and debris.
69a9d77e4fbaa455f0eee860 Description: The standard upper handguard piece for the vz. 58, covering the gas piston tube to protect the user's hand from the heat of the barrel.
69a9d80bdcbd9088b7eee863 Description: The standard lower handguard for the vz. 58 assault rifle, providing a gripping surface for the shooter's support hand.
69aa0ed9742a904a11eee899 Description: The Short upper handguard piece for the vz. 58, covering the gas piston tube to protect the user's hand from the heat of the barrel.
69aa0f6a5e64671cf1eee89c Description: The Short lower handguard for the vz. 58 assault rifle, providing a gripping surface for the shooter's support hand.
69a9d86b8c86b26c6eeee865 Description: The fixed stock for the vz. 58 rifle. Manufactured from a wood-impregnated plastic compound that is affectionately referred to as 'beaver barf' by firearms enthusiasts. It offers decent ergonomics and high durability.
69a9da5c989b7745d0eee86e Description: The standard issue knife bayonet designed to be mounted on the vz. 58 assault rifle. It features a unique attachment mechanism where the blade slides backwards onto the lug.
69a9d93604db219c1deee867 Description: The standard pistol grip for the vz. 58, made from the same iconic 'beaver barf' wood-chip and resin composite as the original stocks and handguards.
69a9d99ddbac50eab8eee869 Description: A lightweight aluminum 30-round magazine designed exclusively for the vz. 58. Unlike AK magazines, it features a built-in follower mechanism to lock the rifle's action open when empty.
69a9dbdcdbaad6de81eee871 Description: A standard 30-round vz. 58 aluminum magazine that has been permanently pinned with a rivet to only accept 5 rounds. Designed strictly to comply with the soul-crushing Canadian civilian firearms regulations. Have fun reloading every two and a half seconds, eh?
69a9d9fa1ba85d4e13eee86c Description: A simple thread-on muzzle device for the vz. 58 rifle, helping to protect the threads.
69aa0d470be3626d9aeee88b Description: The vz. 58 7 Inch is a 7.62x39mm assault rifle designed and manufactured in Czechoslovakia. Imported to North America in the 1990s, these rifles are valued for using standard magazines but can be magazine-picky, with prices now high due to collectibility
69bae79dde9df8f87bfa1bc6 Description: This UltiMAK M1-B gas tube has been modified by a local gunsmith to fit the VZ58 platform. It also serves as a mount for installing reflex sights and tactical devices.

69bc242eafe21c19b7fa1bcb Description: This adapter is intended to adapt M14x1 RH muzzles with M14x1 LH muzzle devices. Made from top quality US steel and finished in black oxide.

69bdda3023f8c5e2416920cd Description: This adapter is intended to adapt M14x1 RH muzzles with .308 caliber muzzle devices. Made from top quality US steel and finished in black oxide.
69bc3161361fdfcdd2fa1bda Name: Infinite Product Solutions M14x1 RH to 1/2-28" Thread Adapter
69bc3161361fdfcdd2fa1bda Description: Convert your 14mm x 1 RH (select SKS, SA VZ-58, and Century VZ2008) barrel threads to 1/2"-28 RH with this premium black stainless steel thread adapter from Infinite Product Solutions! Compatible with both rifle and pistol threads, this is the perfect solution for this particular thread conversion!
69bc291d37403daf02fa1bce Description:
The stock adapter mounts easily on the VZ 58 and accepts any M4 style buffer tube. The adapter is made of aluminum and very light weight. The mounting screw is included with the adapter. Manufactured by Czech Small Arms.
The adapter mounts the tube at the bottom area of the vz.58 receiver and has slight downward angle. Even though this adapter mounts an M4 style stock higher than the original vz.58 wood impregnated buttstock, it still provides a comfortable cheek weld for iron sights.
69bc298c7ccc1024cffa1bd1 Name: StormWerkz Vz-58 1913 Interface Stock Adapter, Type 5
69bc298c7ccc1024cffa1bd1 Description:
Vz-58 stock adapter allows Sig and other brand stocks and braces which mount to a 1913 Picatinny interface to be used on Vz-58

Best stock for use with iron sights is the Sig Minimalist and Minimalist Plus stock.
This adapter mounts the stock inline with the receiver.
This adapter was developed from original Czech receivers, aftermarket receivers may fit tight.
69bc29b28f485315c2fa1bd3 Name: Rs Regulate VZ.58 Zhukov-S Stock Adapter
69bc29b28f485315c2fa1bd3 Description:
Upgrade your firearm with the VZ.58 Zhukov-S Stock Adapter. This top-notch accessory is designed for superior performance and enhanced durability.

The VZ.58 Zhukov-S Stock Adapter ensures a secure fit for any Zhukov-S stock to your VZ.58 rifle, adding versatility and convenience to your shooting experience. Crafted with precision, the adapter is easy to install and offers a seamless fit, improving the overall functionality of your firearm.
69bc2ed044a7c4a09dfa1bd6 Name: C11 Gunworks VZ58 Zhukov Lower Handguard
69bc2ed044a7c4a09dfa1bd6 Description: A Magpul Zhukov Lower Handguard from an AK that has been modified by a local gunsmith to fit the VZ58 platform and allow the bayonet to still be mounted on the rifle.
69e25b7dda6365b5b8ff187b Description: The Aero Precision M5 lower receiver is a commercial AR-10/DPMS pattern receiver milled from 7075-T6 aluminum. 6a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e20 Description: The Aero Precision M5 lower receiver is a commercial AR-10/DPMS pattern receiver milled from 7075-T6 aluminum. Widely known for its reliability and availability on the civilian market, it serves as a highly modular base for custom marksman builds.
69e23553ebf64594eaff184a Description: A commercial AR-10 flat-top upper receiver milled from 7075-T6 aluminum by Aero Precision. Features a forward assist, dust cover, and M4 feed ramps.
69e237d415d999736dff1850 Description: A 13.5-inch precision barrel manufactured by Criterion Barrels for the AR-10/SR-25 platform. Excellent for maneuverable marksman rifles.
69e2392804c7ff61f2ff1854 Description: The Troy Alpha Rail is a lightweight, low-profile modular handguard for AR-10 rifles. Known for aggressive circular cooling holes and a built-in top rail.
69e239f2a9e8af1931ff1856 Description: A heavy 100-round twin-drum magazine manufactured by The Beta Company, designed for AR-10 and SR-25 platforms.
69e24048770bbffb64ff185a Name: Magpul PMAG 20 LR/SR GEN M3 (Tan Camo)
69e24048770bbffb64ff185a Description: A 20-round polymer magazine from Magpul for 7.62 NATO platforms. This one has been custom sprayed with a tan camouflage pattern.
69e240e5d1701dbc14ff185d Name: Hogue OverMolded AR pistol grip (Tan Camo)
69e240e5d1701dbc14ff185d Description: A fiberglass rubber-overmolded anti-slip pistol grip for AR systems, manufactured by Hogue. Sprayed tan camouflage version.
69e2578f9e2f3658f4ff1863 Name: Aero Precision AR10 Breach Ambi Charging Handle
69e2578f9e2f3658f4ff1863 Description: The BREACH charging handle is a rugged, ambidextrous upgrade for AR-10 rifles. Features enlarged levers for fast manipulation.
69e258159d49bea7aaff1867 Name: Aero Precision AR10 Breach Ambi Charging Handle (Tan Camo)
69e258159d49bea7aaff1867 Description: The BREACH charging handle is a rugged, ambidextrous upgrade for AR-10 rifles. Features enlarged levers for fast manipulation. This one has been custom sprayed with a tan camouflage pattern.
69e2592cde11021fc0ff1871 Name: Magpul MOE SL-S Carbine stock (Tan Camo)
69e2592cde11021fc0ff1871 Description: The MOE SL-S provides the same advantages of our MOE SL® but adds two waterproof storage compartments for extra batteries, small parts, or gear. The storage tubes are located to help enhance cheek weld while maintaining its slim profile, maneuverability and fast handling. You’ll get fast adjustments to LOP in a stock that’s optimized to work efficiently with modern gear and slings.
69e2596c1fad487eefff1872 Name: Aero Precision M5 Upper Receiver (Tan Camo)
69e2596c1fad487eefff1872 Description: A commercial AR-10 flat-top upper receiver milled from 7075-T6 aluminum by Aero Precision. Features a forward assist, dust cover, and M4 feed ramps. This one is sprayed with a tan camo
69e258a0c588f36f04ff1869 Description: The Troy Alpha Rail is a lightweight, low-profile modular handguard for AR-10 rifles. Known for aggressive circular cooling holes and a built-in top rail. This one is sprayed tan camo
69e25b190ec5b5b2e3ff1878 Description: A 13.5-inch precision barrel manufactured by Criterion Barrels for the AR-10/SR-25 platform. Excellent for maneuverable marksman rifles. This one is sprayed with a tan camo
69e2558872ca7a7ea2ff1861 Description: The SilencerCo Saker ASR 762 is a heavy-duty, highly durable suppressor designed for rigorous military and law enforcement use on .30 caliber systems.
69e257c4b83e29afacff1864 Name: SilencerCo Saker ASR 762 Sound Suppressor (Tan Camo)
69e257c4b83e29afacff1864 Description: The SilencerCo Saker ASR 762 is a heavy-duty, highly durable suppressor designed for rigorous military and law enforcement use on .30 caliber systems. This one is painted
69e90fbb0655531529ff1891 Description: A standard Colt M4A1 platform converted to fire .22 LR using the CMMG Bravo Stainless Steel Bolt Group. Designed as a cost-effective training tool for the AR-15 platform, it utilizes a blowback operation that bypasses the standard gas system. While significantly reducing recoil and operating costs, it inherits the inherent reliability quirks of rimfire ammunition and requires dedicated magazines.
69e90ce8cbaf23280dff188f Description: A 25-round dedicated .22 LR magazine manufactured by CMMG Inc. for the AR-15 platform. Built from high-impact smoke-colored polymer, these magazines feature a last-round bolt hold-open actuator and are designed specifically to interface with CMMG conversion bolts and dedicated .22 LR uppers.
69e9185e551374ea6fff189a Description: A 14.5-inch dedicated .22 LR barrel from CMMG's 'Resolution' line. Unlike a standard 5.56 barrel, this features a 1:16 twist rate optimized for stabilizing 30-40 grain rimfire projectiles. It lacks a gas port, as the conversion system operates via straight blowback, ensuring superior accuracy and velocity over a drop-in adapter.
69e29e097259deabbcff1884 Description: The Argus Chimera is a ruggedized bridge system designed to mount multiple night vision monoculars, allowing for a panoramic field of view. Milled from aerospace-grade aluminum, it provides the end-user with GPNVG-style peripheral vision using standard tubes. This unit has been finished in a Flat Dark Earth (Tan) Cerakote.
69e3d5854119e71c8cff1885 Description: The Argus Chimera is a modular bridge system designed to expand the field of view by angling dual or quad optics. This high-performance housing allows for individual pod stowage and is finished in an official MultiCam hydrographic pattern for maximum concealment in temperate environments.
69e3d59d816b7c8821ff1887 Description: A specialized version of the Argus Chimera bridge system, designed for extreme cold-weather operations. This panoramic housing allows for a wider horizontal FOV and has been finished in MultiCam Alpine to blend into snow-covered terrain and high-altitude environments.
69e3d5a9609333ebadff188a Name: ACTinBlack DTNVS Dual Tactical Night Vision System
69e3d5a9609333ebadff188a Description: The Dual Tactical Night Vision System (DTNVS) by ACTinBlack is a lightweight, folding binocular housing. Designed for professional users, it features independent pod shut-off when flipped up or out to the side, reducing the silhouette and power consumption. It is widely considered one of the most durable and ergonomic dual-tube systems on the modern market.
69e3d5a8dffbd50412ff1889 Description: The AN/PVS-5A is a vintage second-generation dual-tube night vision system developed by ITT and Litton in the 1970s. Originally designed to be head-mounted with a full face mask, it provided U.S. forces with reliable night-fighting capabilities throughout the late Cold War. While bulky and lacking modern resolution, it remains a functional piece of tactical history.
69ea94d9735c0ab5f2bbee67 Description: The McMillan CS5 (Concealable Subsonic/Supersonic) was designed as a compact, high-precision bolt-action rifle for urban elite units. This core receiver and bolt assembly serves as the foundation for a weapon that can be quickly disassembled and hidden in a backpack, yet maintain sub-MOA accuracy with both standard and subsonic 7.62x51mm NATO loads.
69ea98ca3f62027f4ebbee71 Description: A 1:8 twist match-grade heavy barrel specifically optimized for the CS5 system. The shorter length and faster twist rate allow for excellent stabilization of heavy subsonic projectiles while remaining exceptionally compact.
